description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminPanel web page in an online examination system, primarily handling navigation via button click events to different pages.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminPanel page managing navigation actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the home page (function is empty).

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the SetExam page.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the EditExam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the LoginPage to log out.
